title: Small-cap ETFs may look attractive as recession concerns fade, but blindly chasing the rally is not without risk
description: U.S. small-cap shares are finally starting to join the stock-market rally this week as hopes for a soft landing help drive gains in some of 2023’s worst performers, while megacap technology stocks are taking a breather from its artificial intelligence-driven advance.

title: Why Is Vista Outdoor Stock Surging Today?
description: Vista Outdoor announced the sale of its Revelyst business to Strategic Value Partners for $1.125 billion and an amended merger agreement with Czechoslovak Group to acquire The Kinetic Group for $2.225 billion. The combined deals are expected to deliver around $45 per share in cash to Vista Outdoor stockholders.
